goal: AllocateQuota must allocate exactly capacity units when feasible. Give every request its minimum, distribute the remainder proportionally by positive weight without exceeding maximums, and assign rounding leftovers by largest fractional remainder with ID as tie-break. Reject duplicate IDs, invalid bounds/weights, infeasible capacity, or integer overflow without returning a partial allocation. Inspect the implementation, repair it, and run go test -json ./... without modifying tests.
